notes: US volunteer 501(c)(3) (founded 2008, Federal Tax ID 26-3007676, Schofield, Wisconsin) funding schools, orphanages, wells and eyeglass clinics in several African countries, Tanzania among them. The organisation itself is outside the Arusha-Kilimanjaro area; its Tanzanian link is the two-person 'international team' listed for Arusha. No email is published (contact is by web form, not used), and 'Follow us' has no social links. The board also lists three further directors (Jason Keffeler, Gwen Paul, Lance Hoelscher), not recorded because of the six-person cap; the Corporate Executive Director is not named.

notes: Precision Air is a listed Tanzanian airline headquartered in Dar es Salaam, so this record (segment travel_agency) is probably its Arusha sales office. The site publishes only head-office and national contact-centre routes. Other offices, Arusha included, appear only after choosing from an office dropdown, which was not used (their details are not in the page markup), so the Arusha office's own address and phone were not found. The Nairobi office numbers and email (on a kenya-airways.com address) are outside the area and not recorded. A cookie banner was left untouched (it did not hide the text).
